primitives.name: wave
primitives.summary: a wave of a shape at a frequency

params.name: shape
params.doc: the shape of one cycle, each in [-1, 1]

params.name: hz
params.doc: cycles a second

params.name: stagger
params.doc: how much later each lane reads the wave, inside `lanes(n, …)`

primitives.name: noise
primitives.summary: seeded noise, smooth or in steps

params.name: shape
params.doc: `smooth` is a curve over the drawn values with no kinks, and `steps` holds each for its cycle

params.name: hz
params.doc: drawn values a second

params.name: seed
params.doc: a whole number that picks the draw, hashed with the file's `seed`; by default from the declaration's name

primitives.name: tween
primitives.summary: a move from one value to another, from a cue

params.name: from
params.doc: the value it starts from at its cue; left out, the `to` of the tween `after` names

params.name: to
params.doc: the value it lands on, exactly, at the end of `over`

params.name: at
params.doc: the cue it starts at, or `series[lane]` for a cue a lane

params.name: over
params.doc: how long the move takes from its cue

params.name: ease
params.doc: the curve of the move: a word, or a cubic Bezier's `[x1, y1, x2, y2]`

params.name: after
params.doc: the signal it gives before its cue; without one it holds `from` there

params.name: stagger
params.doc: how much later each lane starts, inside `lanes(n, …)`

primitives.name: spring
primitives.summary: a spring toward goals at cues

params.name: goals
params.doc: the values it heads for, each from its cue, as `[cue: value, …]` or a path's name

params.name: from
params.doc: the value before the first goal, at rest

params.name: time
params.doc: the period of the spring's undamped swing, so omega is 2 pi over it

params.name: overshoot
params.doc: how far a move from rest passes its goal, as a fraction of the move, in [0, 1)

params.name: stagger
params.doc: how much later each lane heads for its goals, inside `lanes(n, …)`

primitives.name: newtonian
primitives.summary: a Newtonian move toward goals at cues

params.name: goals
params.doc: the values it heads for, each from its cue, as `[cue: value, …]` or a path's name

params.name: from
params.doc: the value before the first goal, at rest

params.name: speed
params.doc: the top speed, in units a second

params.name: accel
params.doc: the acceleration while speeding up, in units a second squared

params.name: decel
params.doc: the deceleration while slowing to stop on the goal, in units a second squared

params.name: stagger
params.doc: how much later each lane heads for its goals, inside `lanes(n, …)`

primitives.name: chase
primitives.summary: a spring chasing a signal

params.name: target
params.doc: the signal it heads for, read at each step of 1/480 s

params.name: from
params.doc: the value at the start cue, at rest

params.name: time
params.doc: the period of the spring's undamped swing, so omega is 2 pi over it

params.name: overshoot
params.doc: how far a move from rest passes its goal, as a fraction of the move, in [0, 1)

primitives.name: oscillator
primitives.summary: a wave whose rate is a signal

params.name: shape
params.doc: the shape of one cycle, each in [-1, 1]

params.name: rate
params.doc: the signal of its cycles a second, read at each step of 1/480 s, which may be negative

params.name: phase
params.doc: where in its cycle it is at the start cue, in turns, in [0, 1)

primitives.name: follow
primitives.summary: a follower of goals drawn from regions

params.name: regions
params.doc: the ranges it draws its goals from, as `[low..high, …]` or their name

params.name: from
params.doc: the value at the start cue, at rest

params.name: by
params.doc: how it moves to each goal: `spring(time: …)` or `newtonian(speed: …, accel: …, decel: …)`

params.name: pick
params.doc: how it picks the next range: `cycle` takes them in turn, `random` draws one

params.name: tolerance
params.doc: within this of its goal, and at most this fast in units a second, it has arrived

params.name: pause
params.doc: the shortest and longest rest after it arrives, drawn each time

params.name: seed
params.doc: a whole number that picks the draw, hashed with the file's `seed`; by default from the declaration's name

primitives.name: shift
primitives.summary: a shift register of drawn buckets
primitives.events: the value of the bucket entered

params.name: range
params.doc: the range its buckets' values are drawn from

params.name: buckets
params.doc: how many values it holds and visits in turn, from 1 to 64

params.name: period
params.doc: how long one pass over every bucket takes

params.name: odds
params.doc: the chance in [0, 1] that a bucket is drawn again each pass: 0 repeats, 1 never does

params.name: shape
params.doc: `steps` holds each bucket, `linear` runs to the next, `smooth` curves through the midpoints

params.name: seed
params.doc: a whole number that picks the draw, hashed with the file's `seed`; by default from the declaration's name

primitives.name: delay
primitives.summary: its input from one step before, fed by `<-`

params.name: initial
params.doc: its value at the start cue, before a step of 1/480 s has passed

primitives.name: bounce
primitives.summary: a value bouncing between two walls
primitives.events: the velocity just before the hit: +speed at the top, -speed at the bottom

params.name: range
params.doc: the two walls, `low..high`

params.name: speed
params.doc: how fast it moves between the walls, in units a second

params.name: at
params.doc: the cue it leaves the low wall at, going up, or `series[lane]` for a cue a lane

params.name: stagger
params.doc: how much later each lane starts, inside `lanes(n, …)`

primitives.name: crossing
primitives.summary: a gate on a level, firing at each crossing
primitives.events: the slope over the step of the crossing, in units a second

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it watches, compared at each step of 1/480 s for its events

params.name: level
params.doc: the gate is 1 while the input is at or above it, and 0 below

params.name: direction
params.doc: which crossings fire an event

primitives.name: cues
primitives.summary: the count of cues passed, firing at each
primitives.events: the index of the cue in its table

params.name: first
params.doc: the series it counts, by name, or the one cue it starts at

params.name: count
params.doc: how many cues it counts from `first`, in time order; by default the whole series, or the one cue

primitives.name: input
primitives.summary: a live value the client sets

params.name: range
params.doc: the range a value the client sets is clamped into

params.name: initial
params.doc: its value until the client first sets one

primitives.name: map
primitives.summary: a signal moved from one range to another

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it moves, per component of a vector

params.name: from
params.doc: the input's range that lands on `to`, with no clamp outside it

params.name: to
params.doc: where `from` lands, low end on low end, so `1..0` flips it

primitives.name: abs
primitives.summary: the absolute value of a signal, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it applies to, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: sin
primitives.summary: the sine of a signal in radians, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal, in radians, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: cos
primitives.summary: the cosine of a signal in radians, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal, in radians, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: exp
primitives.summary: e to the power of a signal, held at e^709, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it applies to, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: ln
primitives.summary: the natural log of a signal, held at the log of 2^-1074 at and below 0, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it applies to, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: sqrt
primitives.summary: the square root of a signal, 0 at and below 0, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it applies to, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: floor
primitives.summary: the largest whole number at or below a signal, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it applies to, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: round
primitives.summary: the nearest whole number to a signal, a half away from zero, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it applies to, per component of a vector or a colour

primitives.name: pow
primitives.summary: a signal to a whole power from 2 to 8, per component

params.name: input
params.doc: the signal it applies to, per component of a vector or a colour

params.name: n
params.doc: the power, a whole number literal from 2 to 8

primitives.name: min
primitives.summary: the smaller of two signals, per component

params.name: a
params.doc: one of the two, a number meeting each component of a vector or a colour

params.name: b
params.doc: the other, as `a`

primitives.name: max
primitives.summary: the larger of two signals, per component

params.name: a
params.doc: one of the two, a number meeting each component of a vector or a colour

params.name: b
params.doc: the other, as `a`

primitives.name: vec2
primitives.summary: a 2D vector of two signals

params.name: x
params.doc: the first component, `.x`

params.name: y
params.doc: the second component, `.y`

primitives.name: vec3
primitives.summary: a 3D vector of three signals

params.name: x
params.doc: the first component, `.x`

params.name: y
params.doc: the second component, `.y`

params.name: z
params.doc: the third component, `.z`

primitives.name: oklab
primitives.summary: a colour of three signals: lightness and the a and b axes of OKLab

params.name: l
params.doc: the lightness, from 0 for black to 1 for white

params.name: a
params.doc: the green to red axis, green below 0 and red above

params.name: b
params.doc: the blue to yellow axis, blue below 0 and yellow above

primitives.name: srgb
primitives.summary: a colour of three sRGB numbers in [0, 1], kept as OKLab

params.name: r
params.doc: red, from 0 to 1

params.name: g
params.doc: green, from 0 to 1

params.name: b
params.doc: blue, from 0 to 1

primitives.name: lanes
primitives.summary: its body over n lanes, each with its own `lane`, seeds, and stagger

params.name: count
params.doc: how many lanes, numbered from 0 by `lane`

params.name: body
params.doc: what each lane computes, a name bound outside shared by them all

primitives.name: spring
primitives.summary: a follower's spring

params.name: time
params.doc: the period of the spring's undamped swing, so omega is 2 pi over it

params.name: overshoot
params.doc: how far a move from rest passes its goal, as a fraction of the move, in [0, 1)

primitives.name: newtonian
primitives.summary: a follower's Newtonian move

params.name: speed
params.doc: the top speed, in units a second

params.name: accel
params.doc: the acceleration while speeding up, in units a second squared

params.name: decel
params.doc: the deceleration while slowing to stop on the goal, in units a second squared
